previous_statement: Let gbar be the graph family referred to in lem-stage1-maurer-cartan-trivialization for the fixed algebra and delta. The graph maps supplied there take values in B^{calH}_{2delta}(0) and solve f_U(A^par + gbar_U(A^par)) = 0. The target hypothesis says that, for every U and A^par, g_U(A^par) is the unique element of that same ball solving that same displayed equation; therefore g_U(A^par) = gbar_U(A^par) pointwise.
new_statement: Conditional uniqueness bridge (and no more): suppose, in addition to the registered hypotheses, that the distinguished graph family gbar referred to in lem-stage1-maurer-cartan-trivialization is defined on B^{icalH}_{2delta}(0), takes values in B^{calH}_{2delta}(0), and satisfies f_U(A^par + gbar_U(A^par)) = 0 for every U and A^par. Then the target family's uniqueness hypothesis implies g_U(A^par) = gbar_U(A^par) for every U and A^par. The sole registered external does not supply this additional antecedent, so this node does not assert the unconditional equality g = gbar.
